recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. If broader cleanup is desired for copied line-level subject descriptions in Claim, ClaimResponse, or ExplanationOfBenefit, handle that under a separate FHIR-43309-family review rather than expanding this FHIR-17933 reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-17933 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3 ClaimResponse long-description changes, including subject-of-care wording for patient, payment-date and monetary wording fixes, stale points/double-space cleanup, and insurance/ClaimResponse description clarifications.
initial_application: The large FM batch commit afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a explicitly listed 17933 and changed the then-authoritative ClaimResponse spreadsheet and examples. The later 2021 source rework converted ClaimResponse to structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml, carrying forward many already-applied changes such as payment-date, monetary total, and the absence/removal of old category/net text.
additional_context: ClaimResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-43309 renamed ClaimResponse.patient to ClaimResponse.subject and allowed Patient or Group, while current ClaimResponse patient/group search parameters still use the FHIR-17933 phrase 'The subject of care.' That later change determines the current path for this reconciliation and prevents restoring the old ClaimResponse.patient path.
reconciliation: Changed source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml so ClaimResponse.subject defines the individual or group that is the subject of care and the adjacent requirement refers to the subject with corrected service-history/adjudication wording. No edits were made for issue parts already reflected in current source, removed from the current resource, or superseded by later model changes.
source_changes: source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml: updated ClaimResponse.subject definition to subject-of-care wording for the current Patient/Group-capable subject element.
source/claimresponse/structuredefinition-ClaimResponse.xml: updated ClaimResponse.subject requirements from patient-only typo-laden wording to subject-based service-history/adjudication wording.
